description: Enterprise techniques used by MiniBrowse, ATT&CK software S9062 (v1.0)
name: MiniBrowse (S9062)

techniques.comment: [MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has utilized HTTP POST requests for communications with C2.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has gathered browser data to include Edge login data.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has leveraged JSON to exfiltrate data.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has stolen credentials from Chrome and Edge browsers.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has the ability to upload stolen data over C2 communications.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has sent JSON files to a named pipe.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)

[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has obfuscated code leveraging junk code insertion, control-flow obfuscation, opaque predicates, obfuscated function calls, and encrypted strings to hinder analysis.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has encrypted strings that obfuscate code.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) contains obfuscated code leveraging junk code insertion.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has collected the domain associated with the victim system.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniBrowse](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9062) has the ability to gather the username associated with the victim host.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
